body.x: FLIR System(www.flir.com) unveiled a thermo-graphic camera for outdoor, 'FLIR SCOUT' at ‘Digital Experience!’ which ran Jan. 5 in Las Vegas. 'Digital Experience!' is an annual event only for media, held by Pepcom before the opening of CES. At the event, more than 1,500 journalists had a time to cover CES opening ceremony and startup products in advance.FLIR System’s FLIR SCOUT is designed ergonomically for convenient use. Buttons on the body can utilize all abilities and they are located on the places that users can touch easily. The part of high temperature will be marked with red color through FLIR System’s exclusive technology ‘InstAlert.’ This product tells human from wild animals easily.It provides clear images at day and night with 320 x 240 of high resolution. As Li-ion battery is loaded, it can be used for five to seven hours by one charge. The best strength of FLIR SCOUT is its convenience and transportability.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products.
